rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is quite or somewhat so, as in 幾乾.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when an action is carried out impartially rather than favouring one side.

example.jyutping: gung1 ping4 gam2 fan1 pui3 di1 zi1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for the “properly” meaning, especially when saying that something is done carefully or as it should be.

example.english: They completed the report fairly well.
example.traditional: 佢哋好好咁完成份報告。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hou2 hou2 gam2 jyun4 sing4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.jyutping: lou5 lou5 sat6 sat6 gam2 V
rows.note: Use this for the “honestly” meaning when straightforwardness or truthfulness is being emphasized.

example.jyutping: nei5 lou5 lou5 sat6 sat6 gam2 daap3 ngo5 laa1
